input_coverage.meaning: The input is accepted 4.0, schema-valid, and every applicable target of every v1 rule was checked. Says nothing about relationships outside the profile.

coverage_limits: MusicXML 4.0 schema validates structure; documents declaring another version are audited with a stated qualification and their schema errors stay review observations.
Only relationships named in the v1 acceptance profile are checked. Content absent from the XML is never inferred; no source-image comparison, BRF decoding or SMB output guarantee.

Navigation is executed for ordinary repeats, endings and one D.C./D.S. with Fine or To Coda/Coda; arbitrary interacting jump programs are reported unsupported, and conventional defaults for repeat times and after-jump are recorded as assumptions.
Free text, custom glyphs (other-* elements, smufl), specialized tuning and genuinely ambiguous ownership are localized limitations, never change requests.
No artistic fingering, phrasing, enharmonic spelling, ornament realization, lyric language or specialist Braille reading judgement.

acceptance_profile.meaning: checker_profile_complete describes the checker against the v1 contract; input_coverage_complete describes this file only.
